blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) in neuroimaging enables the identification of structurally similar brain scans, supporting diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment planning; however, existing methods are often limited to small datasets, single brain regions, or coarse class labels, thereby restricting their clinical utility and generalizability.
Here, we present NeuroCBIR, a framework for fast and flexible retrieval of both whole-brain and region-specific 3D T1w MRI scans. A total of 103 cortical and subcortical regions are extracted to enable both whole-brain and region-level queries.
NeuroCBIR leverages latent representations learned by a variational autoencoder (VAE) combined with contrastive learning, producing scan-specific embeddings that capture anatomical patterns. These embeddings were evaluated for subject re-identification, zero-shot age prediction, and zero-shot multi-class pathology stratification. Re-identification performance was high across both whole-brain and brain-region levels (mean average precision across the top-5 retrieved images (mAP@5) ≥ 98.4 % \geq 98.4\% ), with robust generalization across datasets and acquisition conditions. While NeuroCBIR is not trained for age prediction or pathology stratification, zero-shot evaluations for these two tasks demonstrate that the embeddings encode meaningful information for downstream tasks.
Embedding extraction on a 4-core CPU required ∼ \sim 18.7s per scan, whereas similarity search was effectively instantaneous (<0.01s).
NeuroCBIR is publicly available for brain MRI with > 26 000 26\,000 precomputed T1w MRI embeddings. It supports reproducible research, region-specific flexibility, and clinically meaningful personalized diagnostic support. The software is available at https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR .

这里,我们介绍NeuroCBIR,这是快速而灵活的检索全脑和区域特有3D T1w磁共振扫描的框架. 共取出103个地皮和亚地皮区域,以便进行全脑和地区一级的查询。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) plays a central role in the study and diagnosis of neurological disorders, providing high-resolution, non-invasive insights into brain structure, function, and pathology. With the increasing availability of large-scale neuroimaging datasets, such as those developed for the study of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and normal aging ( Jack et al., 2008 ; Ellis et al., 2009 ; LaMontagne et al., 2019 ) , the volume of data available to clinicians and researchers has increased greatly. Manual searches of extensive databases are neither efficient nor practical. The adoption of innovative computer-aided diagnosis methods, particularly Content-Based Image Retrieval (CBIR) ( Huang et al., 2012 ; Onga et al., 2019 ; Dogan et al., 2025 ; Tobari et al., 2025 ) , unlocks new possibilities. CBIR systems aim to retrieve images similar to a given query based on intrinsic image features rather than metadata. In the context of neuroimaging, CBIR offers the potential to assist clinicians and scientists by providing fast access to comparable cases, thus facilitating clinical decision making, supporting differential diagnosis, and enabling population-level analyses by efficiently identifying subjects with similar structural or functional brain patterns across large datasets.
blocks.zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)在神经系统紊乱的研究和诊断中起中心作用,对大脑结构,功能,病理提供了高分辨率,非侵入性的洞察. 随着大规模神经成像数据集的不断普及,如为研究阿尔茨海默氏病(AD)和正常衰老而开发的数据集(Jack等,2008年;Ellis等,2009年;LaMontagne等,2019年),临床医生和研究人员可获得的数据量大大增加. 对广泛的数据库进行人工搜索既不有效也不实际。 采用创新的计算机辅助诊断方法,特别是基于内容的图像检索(CBIR)(Huang等,2012年;Onga等,2019年;Dogan等,2025年;Tobari等,2025年),释放出新的可能性。 CBIR系统旨在取回类似基于内在图像特征而不是元数据的给定查询的图像. 在神经成像方面,CBIR通过提供快速的可比较病例获取途径,从而提供了协助临床医生和科学家的潜力,从而便利临床决策,支持差异诊断,并通过有效识别在大型数据集中具有类似结构或功能性大脑模式的主体来促成人口层面的分析.

blocks.en: In Table 1 , we summarize the different CBIR systems for brain MRI data found in the literature. Early CBIR systems relied on handcrafted feature extraction and statistical models. In these early approaches, features were neuroanatomically meaningful (volume or intensity of atlas regions) and retrieval performance was high but typically evaluated on specific disorders. For instance, Huang et al. (2012) used a region-specific bag-of-visual-words model on contrast-enhanced T1 brain MRIs (meningioma, glioma, pituitary tumors), learning a similarity metric via distance metric learning. This achieved a mean average precision (mAP) ≈ 91 \approx 91 % across multiple views.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,我们概述了文献中发现的大脑核磁共振数据的不同CBIR系统. 早期的CBIR系统依赖于手工地物提取和统计模型. 在这些早期方法中,特征具有神经解剖意义(图集区域的体积或强度),检索性能很高,但通常对特定失调情况进行评价。 例如,Huang等人(2012年)在对比增强的T1脑MRI(脑膜瘤、胶瘤、垂体瘤)上采用了一个区域特有包式可视字模型,通过远程计量学习学习类似度量衡。 这在多种观点中实现了平均精确度(mAP) ~ 91\ 大约91%。

blocks.en: In the past 5 years, deep learning has reshaped the field of CBIR. Many available methods use convolutional networks or autoencoders to learn low-dimensional embeddings directly from images. In the work of Deepak and Ameer (2020) , T1-weighted tumor MRIs were passed through a pretrained convolutional neural network (CNN) and then a 2D siamese embedding trained with contrastive loss, achieving a tumor-retrieval performance of mAP@10 ≈ 97.6 \approx 97.6 % (mAP across the top-10 retrieved images). Likewise, the study by Onga et al. (2019) combined a 3D convolutional autoencoder (3D-CAE) with deep metric learning in patients with AD. It compressed full-resolution 3D MRIs by 4096:1 while preserving AD-related features. The learned embedding improved the separation between AD and cognitively normal (CN) cases by 29.1% compared to a vanilla 3D-CAE. Similarly, Nishimaki et al. (2022) proposed Loc-VAE, a localized β-VAE that enforces each latent dimension to correspond to a specific brain region. Loc-VAE compressed at 4096:1, preserving disease signals while enhancing “locality” of features. Furthermore, the study by Muraki et al. (2024) described IE-CBIR, an isometric VAE embedding with 4096:1 compression. This method achieved an accuracy of 91.5% for discriminating AD vs. CN using the latent representation. In a different line of work, Dogan et al. (2025) combined deep and handcrafted features using a CNN (EfficientNet-B0) and Local Binary Patterns (LBP), followed by minimum redundancy–maximum relevance (mRMR) feature selection. This hybrid CBIR-classifier achieved 98.9% accuracy over eight brain-MRI categories (including glioma, meningioma and AD). More recently, Tobari et al. (2025) introduced a Style Encoder Adversarial Domain Adaptation (SE-ADA) model to improve CBIR robustness across multi-cohort MRI datasets, achieving an F1-score of 74.7% in AD vs. CN retrieval.
blocks.zh: 在过去5年中,深入学习重新塑造了CBIR的领域. 许多可得到的方法使用分解网络或自发编码器直接从图像中学习出低维嵌入. 在Deepak和Ameer(2020年)的作品中,T1加权的肿瘤MRI通过预受训练的进化神经网络(CNN)传递,再由2D的暹罗嵌入被训练出具有对比性损失,实现了mAP@10X97.6\大约97.6%的肿瘤检索性能(mAP横跨上-10检索到的图像). 同样地,由Onga等人(2019年)进行的研究将3D分解自编码器(3D-CAE)与AD患者的深度计量学结合. 它在保留AD相关特性的同时将全分辨率的3DMRI压缩了4096:1. 与香草3D-CAE相比,所学到的嵌入法使AD和认知正常(CN)病例的分离率提高了29.1%。 同样地,Nishimaki等人(2022年)提出了Loc-VAE,一种本地化的β-VAE,它强化了每个潜在的维度,以对应特定的大脑区域. Loc-VAE压缩为4096:1,保存疾病信号,同时增强特征的"位置". 此外,由Muraki等人(2024年)进行的研究描述了IE-CBIR,一种同位素VAE嵌入了4096:1的压缩. 这种方法对使用潜在代表的AD对CN进行歧视的准确度为91.5%。 不同行间多干等. (2025年)使用有线电视新闻网(EfficentNet-B0)和本地二进制模式(LBP)合并了深层和手工制作的功能,之后是最小冗余-最大相关性(mRMR)特征选择. 这种混合CBIR分级器在8个脑-MRI类(包括胶原瘤、脑膜瘤和AD)中实现了98.9%的精度。 最近,Tobari 等(2025年)推出了一种“Sytle Encoder Adversarial Domain Resignation(SE-ADA)”模式,以提高CBIR在多曲线磁共振数据集中的稳健性,在AD对CN检索中达到74.7%的F1-分数。

blocks.en: Alternatively, the study by Puglisi et al. (2024) addressed subject-level re-identification 1 1 1 Re-identification refers to the task of correctly matching scans from the same subject across different time points or datasets, ensuring that repeated imaging of an individual can be reliably retrieved. by generating a fingerprint from 2D T1-weighted MRIs, achieving mAP@3 of 95.5% on the ADNI dataset. While demonstrating the feasibility of retrieving previous scans of the same patient, their study was limited to small 2D datasets.
blocks.zh: 或者,由Puglisi等人(2024年)进行的研究涉及主题层面的重新识别 1 1 重新识别是指在不同的时间点或数据集中正确匹配同一主题的扫描,确保个人的重复成像能够可靠地取回的任务. 通过从2D T1加权MRI中生成指纹,在ADNI数据集上实现95.5%的mAP@3. 在展示检索同一患者之前的扫描的可行性的同时,他们的研究仅限于小的2D数据集.

blocks.en: Parallel to these MRI-focused efforts, Denner et al. (2025) investigated the use of large-scale vision foundation models for medical CBIR in radiology. Using over 1.6 million images spanning multiple modalities and 161 pathologies, they benchmarked off-the-shelf embeddings from BiomedCLIP, CLIP, and other vision foundation models. Their results showed that foundation models can achieve competitive retrieval performance, Precision@10 = 58.3%, highlighting the potential of general-purpose embeddings for scaling CBIR to heterogeneous radiology datasets.
blocks.zh: 在开展这些以核磁共振为重点的努力的同时,Denner等人(2025年)调查了在放射学中使用CBIR医学的大规模视觉基础模型. 它们利用超过160万幅跨越多种模式和161个病理的图像,以BiomedCLIP、CLIP和其他视觉基础模型的现成嵌入物为基准。 其结果显示,基础模型可以实现竞争性检索性能,Precise@10=58.3%,突出了将CBIR缩放到多相异放射数据集的通用嵌入的潜力.

blocks.en: The existing CBIR approaches described above are typically constrained by limited datasets, restricted applicability to specific brain regions, and a lack of evaluation across heterogeneous MRI acquisition protocols. Moreover, to the best of our knowledge, no publicly available system currently provides a CBIR framework for multiple brain-region MRI data.
blocks.zh: 上述现有的CBIR方法通常受到以下因素的限制:数据集有限、对特定大脑区域的适用性有限,以及缺乏对各种核磁共振获取协议的评估。 此外,据我们所知,目前没有公开的系统为多种脑区域核磁共振数据提供一个CBIR框架。

blocks.en: Our work leverages five large-scale datasets (ADNI, OASIS3, AIBL, MIRIAD, and SLIM), enabling evaluation across diverse populations, scanner manufacturers, and field strengths. A key advantage of our proposed CBIR system (NeuroCBIR) is that, although it employs deep learning for image retrieval, the retrieved results consist exclusively of expert-curated, real-world clinical data.  We extend CBIR beyond the whole-brain level by supporting retrieval at the brain-region level, covering a total of 103 cortical and subcortical brain regions. This regional flexibility enhances medical usability by allowing clinicians and researchers to query specific regions of interest according to their diagnostic needs, thereby enabling more precise and context-driven retrieval.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作利用了5个大型数据集(ADNI、OASIS3、AIBL、MIRIAD和SLIM),使得能够对不同人群、扫描仪制造商和现场优势进行评价。 我们提议的CBIR系统(NeuroCBIR)的一个关键优势是,虽然它采用深入的学习来取回图像,但取回的结果完全是专家精密的、真实世界的临床数据。 我们通过支持大脑区域的检索,将CBIR扩展到整个大脑层面之外,覆盖了总共103个皮层和亚层大脑区域. 这种区域灵活性通过允许临床医生和研究人员根据其诊断需要对具体感兴趣的区域进行查询,从而提高了医疗可用性,从而能够进行更精确和基于具体情况的检索。

blocks.en: From a technical perspective, we introduce a retrieval framework that couples VAE-derived latent embeddings with contrastive learning using a multi-positive ranking loss. This design exploits multiple valid matches per query, producing stable and scalable embeddings that support efficient and anatomically meaningful MRI retrieval ( Cheng et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 从技术角度来说,我们引入了一个检索框架,即夫妇利用多阳性排名损失,通过对比性学习来进行VAE衍生的潜在嵌入。 这种设计利用每个查询的多个有效匹配,产生稳定和可伸缩的嵌入,支持高效和解剖有意义的核磁共振检索(Cheng等,2025;Tang等,2023)。

blocks.en: A central goal of NeuroCBIR is accurate re-identification of same-subject scans at both whole-brain and region-specific levels. Simultaneously, the embedding space is explicitly structured to rank anatomically similar inter-subject samples close to each query while separating dissimilar ones, ensuring that retrieved cases are truly comparable. This provides a reliable foundation for downstream zero-shot analyses and clinical interpretation, and enables efficient re-identification within large-scale imaging repositories.
blocks.zh: NeuroCBIR的一个中心目标是准确重新识别全脑和区域特有层面的同题扫描. 同时,嵌入空间的结构明确是为了在解剖学上将与每个查询相近的相近的主体间样本排序,同时将相异的样本相分离,确保检索的病例真正具有可比性。 这为下游零发分析和临床判读提供了可靠的基础,并使得在大型成像储存库中能够有效地重新识别.

blocks.en: Accordingly, the main contributions of this study are: 1. Design a fast and flexible framework for both whole-brain and region-specific retrieval, thereby enhancing clinical applicability. 2. Evaluate retrieval robustness across multiple datasets, MRI acquisition protocols, and imaging domains (scanner manufacturer and field strength). 3. Evaluate whether the learned retrieval embeddings capture clinically meaningful information beyond accurate re-identification, by assessing their utility in zero-shot downstream tasks such as age estimation and disease risk inference. 4. Publicly release a CBIR system for brain MRI, capable of retrieving the most similar real-world imaging cases to support personalized diagnosis and tailored treatment decisions. We intend to share the source code and precomputed image features, ensuring reproducibility while respecting data privacy and institutional data-sharing constraints.
blocks.zh: 因此,这项研究的主要贡献是: 1. 设计一个快速而灵活的全脑和区域检索框架,从而提高临床适用性。 2. 评价多个数据集、核磁共振购置协议和成像域(扫描器制造商和现场强度)的检索强度。 3. 评估所学的检索嵌入是否收集了临床上有意义的信息,超出了准确的再识别范围,方法是评估这些信息在零射入下游任务中的用途,如年龄估计和疾病风险推断。 4. 公开发布大脑核磁共振的CBIR系统,能够检索最相近的现实世界成像病例,支持个性化诊断和量身定制的治疗决定. 我们打算分享源代码和预计算图像特征,确保可复制,同时尊重数据隐私和体制数据共享限制。

We intend to share the source code and precomputed image features, ensuring reproducibility while respecting data privacy and institutional data-sharing constraints.

blocks.en: 2 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 材料和方法

blocks.en: This section describes the MRI datasets and the methodologies employed in this study. Two CBIR frameworks were developed, one based on whole-brain scans and the other on segmented brain-regions. Since both frameworks share the majority of their processing pipeline, the common components are presented jointly, while the specific differences are clearly indicated throughout the text.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍本研究中使用的磁共振数据集和方法。 制定了两个CBIR框架,一个基于全脑扫描,另一个基于分块脑区域. 由于两个框架都拥有大部分加工流程,因此共同的构成部分是一并列出的,而具体的差异则在整个案文中明确列出。

blocks.en: All source code, trained models, and precomputed embeddings are publicly available at https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR . A reproducibility script ( dev/run_reproducibility_check.py ) enables full replication of model training, embedding extraction, and retrieval evaluation. This ensures that all results reported in the manuscript can be independently reproduced by other researchers.
blocks.zh: 所有源代码、训练有素的模型和预计算嵌入物均可在https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR上公开查阅。 一个可复制的脚本(dev/run_republicibility_check.py)可以完全复制模型训练,嵌入取取和检索评价. 这确保了手稿中报告的所有结果可以被其他研究人员独立地复制.

blocks.en: We first introduce the datasets and their corresponding preprocessing steps. Next, we describe the methodological framework, which includes: the architecture of the variational autoencoder (VAE) and its training procedure, as well as the encoder–projector model architecture and its training using contrastive learning. Finally, we outline the evaluation metrics applied in the different experimental scenarios, together with the statistical tests used for performance assessment.
blocks.zh: 我们首先介绍数据集及其相应的预处理步骤。 其次,我们描述了方法框架,其中包括:可变自编码器(VAE)的架构及其培训程序,以及编码器-预测模型架构及其利用对比性学习进行的培训。 最后,我们概述了在不同试验情景中适用的评价指标,以及用于业绩评估的统计测试。

blocks.en: 1. The ADNI 2 2 2 Data used in the preparation of this article were obtained from the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) database ( http://adni.loni.usc.edu ). The ADNI was launched in 2003 as a public-private partnership, led by Principal Investigator Michael W. Weiner, MD. The primary goal of ADNI has been to test whether serial magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), positron emission tomography (PET), other biological markers, and clinical and neuropsychological assessment can be combined to measure the progression of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and early Alzheimer’s disease (AD). For up-to-date information, see http://www.adni-info.org . dataset is a comprehensive resource comprising clinical, imaging, genetic, cognitive, and biomarker data from individuals with varying cognitive statuses, including CN, mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD ( Jack et al., 2008 ) . For this study, we used > 20 971 20\,971 images from 2422 subjects. Data were acquired longitudinally using scanners from multiple manufacturers, including Siemens, General Electric, and Philips, at field strengths of 1.5T and 3T (see Table 2 ). This dataset contains repeated MRI scans acquired within the same imaging session, providing multiple consecutive acquisitions of the same subject under identical conditions (denoted as N R \mathrm{N_{R}} in Table 2 ). These repetitions help assess within-session variability and improve the reliability of longitudinal analyses. 2. The OASIS3 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies 3) is a longitudinal, multimodal neuroimaging dataset that integrates clinical, cognitive, and biomarker data to study normal aging and AD ( LaMontagne et al., 2019 ) . As stated on Table 2 , the dataset includes 1316 participants with 2681 MRI sessions acquired on Siemens scanners at 1.5T and 3T. 3. The MIRIAD (Minimal Interval Resonance Imaging in Alzheimer’s Disease) dataset provides longitudinal T1w MRI scans from 46 patients with mild-to-moderate AD and 23 healthy elderly controls ( Malone et al., 2013 ) . Scans were acquired at short intervals (2 weeks to 2 years) using General Electric scanners at 1.5T (see Table 2 ). This dataset contains repeated MRI scans for the same session. 4. The AIBL 3 3 3 Data was collected by the AIBL study group. AIBL study methodology has been reported previously (Ellis et al. 2009). dataset combines MRI and PET imaging with clinical, cognitive, genetic, and lifestyle measures ( Ellis et al., 2009 ) . For this work, we used 1296 T1w scans from 691 participants either at risk for or diagnosed with AD. Data were acquired on Siemens scanners at 1.5T and 3T (see Table 2 ). 5. The SLIM (Southwest University Longitudinal Imaging Multimodal) dataset includes multimodal MRI data and behavioral assessments from healthy young adults of around 21 years old ( Liu et al., 2017 ) . The longitudinal study spans 3.5 years, with 3 time points to study brain–behavior correlations and test–retest reliability. blocks.en: To quantitatively evaluate the differences among datasets, we computed the Fréchet AutoEncoder Distance (FAED) between each pair of datasets using features extracted from a pretrained 3D medical image autoencoder ( Buzuti and Thomaz, 2023 ) . This metric, inspired by the widely used Fréchet Inception Distance in the GAN literature ( Heusel et al., 2018 ) , measures the distance between the feature distributions of two datasets and is sensitive to differences in image quality and content ( Heusel et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了从数量上评估数据集之间的差异,我们利用从预先训练的3D医疗图像自动编码器(Buzuti和Thomaz,2023年)中提取的特性计算出每对数据集之间的Frechet自动编码器距离。 这一度量由GAN文献中被广泛使用的Fréchet Inception距离(Heusel等,2018年)所启发,测量出两个数据集的特征分布之间的距离,并对图像质量和内容的差异十分敏感(Heusel等,2018年).

blocks.en: For each dataset, 200 samples were randomly selected. Then, the FAED between datasets was computed in the feature space of a pretrained 3D ResNet-10 from MONAI ( Hara et al., 2018 ; He et al., 2016 ; Chen et al., 2019 ; Cardoso et al., 2022 ) . The results are summarized in Figure 1 . We observed relatively low distances among the ADNI, AIBL, MIRIAD, and OASIS3 datasets, meaning these four datasets are largely comparable. In contrast, the SLIM dataset showed higher distances with the other datasets. We attribute these higher distances to the noticeably younger population for the SLIM dataset compared to the other four datasets.
blocks.zh: 每个数据集随机选取200个样本. 随后,数据集之间的FAED在MONAI预训3D ResNet-10的地物空间被计算出(Hara等,2018;He等,2016;Chen等,2019;Cardoso等,2022). 图1汇总了结果。 我们观测到ADNI、AIBL、MIRIAD和OASIS3数据集之间的距离相对较低,这意味着这四个数据集基本上可以比较。 相形之下,SLIM数据集显示与其他数据集相距更远. 与其他四个数据集相比,我们把这些距离较大的数据归结为SLIM数据集明显年轻的人口。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Pairwise FAED between MRI datasets stratified by MRI field strength (1.5T and 3.0T). Lower values indicate greater similarity in feature distributions, while higher values reflect larger domain shifts. White cells correspond to uncomputed comparisons. The comparisons were done with the fully-preprocessed brain images.
blocks.zh: 图1:磁共振数据集之间按磁共振场强度分级的对等FAED(1.5T和3.0T). 更低的值表示在特征分布上具有更大的相似性,而更高的值则反映了更大的域位变化. 白细胞对应无对比. 与经过充分处理的大脑图像进行了比较。

blocks.en: 2.2 Imaging prepossessing
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像预置

blocks.en: We followed the preprocessing protocol described in Fu et al. (2025) . Specifically, we used skull-stripped and bias field–corrected T1w images processed according to the FreeSurfer process flow 4 4 4 https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/ReconAllDevTable (i.e., norm , 1 mm isotropic). We affinely registered each image to the FreeSurfer Talairach space. We then rescaled image intensities to [0,1] and cropped them to [160, 176, 208] , starting from [48, 38, 10]. We determined this crop size to preserve most foreground information based on 200 randomly selected scans.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循了Fu等人(2025年)描述的预处理协议. 具体地说,我们使用了头骨被划出并带有偏见的字段 – 按照FreeSurfer 流程处理的 T1w 图像 4 4 4 https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/ReconAll DevTable(即规范., 1毫米同分色. 我们在FreeSurfer Talairach的空间上记录了每个图像。 然后,我们从[48、38、10]起,将图像强度调整到[0、1]并剪接到[160、176、208]。 我们根据200个随机选取的扫描结果确定这个作物大小,以保存大多数前缘信息.

blocks.en: We used FreeSurfer-processed brain segmentation masks (i.e., aseg+aparc ) for training and evaluation. For the ADNI and OASIS3 datasets, we obtained segmentations from FreeSurfer v5.3.0 in TheHiveDB platform ( Muehlboeck et al., 2014 ) . We segmented the AIBL, MIRIAD, and SLIM datasets using FastSurfer 5 5 5 FastSurfer is a deep learning–based reimplementation of FreeSurfer. v2.4.2 ( Henschel et al., 2020 ) . These masks delineate cortical and subcortical regions, enabling both global and region-specific analyses. In total, we included 103 cortical and subcortical regions in this study.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了FreeSurfer处理过的脑分解口罩(即aseg+aparc)来进行培训和评价. 对于ADNI和OASIS3数据集,我们在TheHiveDB平台(Muehlboeck等,2014年)获得了FreeSurfer v5.3.0的分解. 使用 FastSurfer 5 5 5 FastSurfer 的 AIBL 、 MIRIAD 和 SLIM 数据集是 FreeSurfer 的深层学习-基于再应用 。 v2.4.2 (Henschel等,2020年). 这些口罩划定了地皮和亚地皮区域,使得能够进行针对全球和区域的分析。 本研究共包括了103个皮层和亚层区域.

blocks.en: As part of quality control, images with low mutual information with respect to the FreeSurfer Talairach template were visually inspected, and scans showing evident preprocessing failures were excluded ( Iglesias, 2023 ) . The data reported in Table 2 correspond to the dataset after this screening step.
blocks.zh: 作为质量控制的一部分,对FreeSurfer Talairach模板的相互信息较少的图像进行了目视检查,排除了显示明显预处理失败的扫描(Iglesias, 2023)。 表2中报告的数据与这一筛选步骤之后的数据集相对应。

blocks.en:
A dataset of brain regions was derived from all original brain datasets.
We defined a common bounding box for each of the 103 brain regions using 500 randomly selected brains. We then segmented and cropped all regions based on these bounding boxes and resampled them to a universal size of [64, 64, 64] using trilinear interpolation. As an example, we cropped the left hippocampus using coordinates [57, 31, 0] to [153, 175, 192], yielding an initial size of [96, 144, 192], which we subsequently resampled to [64, 64, 64].
blocks.zh:
从所有原始的大脑数据集中得出了大脑区域数据集.
我们用500个随机选取的大脑 定义了103个大脑区域中的每个区域 一个共同的边框 然后,我们根据这些相接的盒子对所有区域进行分块和收割,并利用三线插值将它们复制到[64、64、64]的通用尺寸。 例如,我们用坐标[57、31、0]到[153、175、192]对左河马进行裁剪,最初的体积为[96、144、192],我们随后将其重新印为[64、64、64]。

blocks.en: 2.3 Dataset setup
blocks.zh: 2.3 数据集设置

blocks.en: We used the ADNI and OASIS3 datasets for training, validation and testing, while reserving the AIBL, MIRIAD, and SLIM datasets exclusively for external testing. The ADNI and OASIS3 datasets were split at the subject level, allocating approximately 80% of subjects for training, 10% for validation and 10% for testing. Each partition was stratified to maintain the same proportion of dementia patients and healthy subjects. For subjects with longitudinal scans, all MRI examinations from the same individual were assigned the label corresponding to the most recent available clinical assessment. Notice that during training, we do not use the class, only the subject identity.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ADNI和OASIS3数据集进行培训、验证和测试,同时将AIBL、MIRIAD和SLIM数据集专门用于外部测试。 ADNI和OASIS3数据集在学科一级划分,大约80%的科目用于培训,10%用于验证,10%用于测试。 每个区划都进行了分级,以保持精神病患者和健康对象的比例相同。 对于有纵向扫描的科目,同一个人的所有核磁共振检查都得到了与最新临床评估相对应的标签。 注意在训练期间,我们不使用课程,只使用主题身份.

blocks.en: Two different datasets were considered: one comprising whole-brain scans and another containing segmented brain regions. These were used to train and evaluate the two separate CBIR frameworks.
blocks.zh: 考虑了两个不同的数据集:一个包括全脑扫描,另一个包括分脑区域。 这些工具被用来培训和评价两个独立的CBIR框架。

The decoder ( D θ D_{\theta} ) reconstructs the image, optimized using an L 1 L_{1} loss, latent regularization ( L KL L_{\mathrm{KL}} ), perceptual loss, and an adversarial loss with critic ( C ψ C_{\psi} ).

blocks.en: 2.4 Framework of NeuroCBIR
blocks.zh: 2.4 神经CBIR框架

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents a schematic overview of the NeuroCBIR training and inference workflow. In the first training stage, NeuroCBIR extracts latent representations from input images using a VAE. Then, these precomputed representations are passed to an encoder–projector model with contrastive learning to pull together intra-subject (similar) images and push apart inter-subject (dissimilar) ones. The resulting compact embeddings enable NeuroCBIR to efficiently perform similarity comparisons and retrieve the top- k k most similar images during inference.
blocks.zh: 图2概述了神经化学和生物物理研究所的培训和推论工作流程。 在第一个培训阶段,NeuroCBIR利用VAE从输入图像中提取出潜在的表示. 然后,这些预估的表达被传递给一个编码器-投影器模型,具有对比性的学习,将主体内部(类似)的图像拉在一起并推开主体间(不同)的图像. 由此产生的紧凑嵌入使NeuroCBIR能够高效地进行相似性比较,并在推导时取回最上-克最相似的图像.

blocks.en: 2.4.1 VAE-GAN
blocks.zh: 2.4.1 VAE-GAN

blocks.en: We used a VAE to learn latent representations because of its inference efficiency ( Rombach et al., 2021 ; Pinaya et al., 2022 ) . Specifically, we followed the VAE-GAN framework from Rombach et al. (2021) ; Pinaya et al. (2022) and trained two separate models for whole-brain and brain-regional data, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们使用VAE来学习潜在的表达方式,因为它的推论效率(Rombach等人,2021年;Pinaya等人,2022年). 具体地说,我们遵循了来自Rombach等人(2021年);Pinaya等人(2022年)的VAE-GAN框架,并分别培训了两个单独的全脑和脑-区域数据模型.

blocks.en: We used the AutoencoderKL model from the MONAI library ( Cardoso et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2021 ; Pinaya et al., 2022 ) . It uses an encoder–bottleneck–decoder structure, where both encoder E E and decoder D D implement four residual convolutional layers with 64, 128, 128, and 128 filters, using group normalization. The discriminator C C implements three convolutional layers of 32 filters each, using instance normalization.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了MONAI图书馆的AutoencoderKL模型(Cardoso等,2022;Rombach等,2021;Pinaya等,2022)。 它使用编码器-bottleneck-解码器结构,其中编码器E E和解码器DD都执行有64个,128个,128个和128个滤波器的4个剩余分层,使用组态. 歧视者C C 采用例常化方式,执行三个各有32个过滤器的分层.

blocks.en: Each encoder block reduces the spatial resolution of the input volume through strided convolutions, progressively compressing the feature maps into a latent representation with 8 channels. For a given anchor query, hard positives are defined by shared identity labels, while soft and hard negatives are selected using percentile thresholds applied to the VAE latent similarity. blocks.en: 2.6 Interpretability
blocks.zh: 2.6 可解释性

blocks.en: Region-based retrieval is inherently interpretable because similarity can be directly linked to specific, anatomically defined brain regions. In contrast, whole-brain embeddings are high-dimensional and spatially distributed, making it difficult to identify which regions drive similarity-based retrieval. To better understand the regional contributions underlying whole-brain similarity, we performed a correlation analysis between whole-brain and region-specific similarities.
blocks.zh: 以区域为基础的检索具有内在的解释性,因为相似性可以直接与特定,解剖定义的大脑区域相联. 相形之下,全脑嵌入具有高维度和空间分布,使得难以确定哪个区域驱动以相似性为基础的检索. 为了更好地了解整个大脑相似性背后的区域贡献,我们进行了整个大脑与特定区域相似性之间的关联分析。

blocks.en: A set of 100 whole-brain query scans was randomly selected. For each query, we retrieved the top-50, top-200, and top-1000 most similar cases based on the whole-brain embedding, excluding scans from the same subject. For these retrieved cases, cosine similarity scores were also computed independently for each anatomical region using the region-based retrieval pipeline.
blocks.zh: 随机选择了一套100个全脑查询扫描. 对于每个查询,我们检索了基于全脑嵌入的上-50,上-200和上-1000最相近的病例,不包括同一主体的扫描. 对于这些取回的个案,还利用基于区域的取回管道,独立计算每个解剖区的同位素相似性分数。

blocks.en: To quantify each region’s contribution to whole-brain similarity, we computed the Spearman rank correlation between whole-brain similarity scores and region-specific similarity scores across the retrieved samples. Intuitively, a high correlation for a given region indicates that the region alone can largely explain the similarity ranking produced by the whole-brain embedding. Correlations were computed separately for each top- k k setting.
blocks.zh: 为了量化每个区域对全脑相似性的贡献,我们计算出全脑相似性分数和所有取回样本中特定区域相似性分数之间的关联。 直觉上,特定区域的高度关联性表明,仅该区域就可以在很大程度上解释由全脑嵌入产生的相似性排名. 每个顶- k 设置的关联度分别计算 。

blocks.en: Finally, to summarize variability in regional contributions, we computed the coefficient of variation (CV), defined as the ratio of the standard deviation to the mean of the Spearman correlations. CV was evaluated both across regions for each query and across queries for each region. We interpret the CV values as follows:

High CV across regions for a query indicates that individual regions vary in their influence on whole-brain similarity for that query. 3. Low CV across queries for a region indicates that this region consistently contributes to the top- k k retrieval across different queries, i.e., the retrieval process relies more heavily on this region in general.

blocks.en: 2.7 Bias evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.7 联合国 偏见评价

blocks.en: Each dataset was acquired under different study protocols and included different populations. Moreover, within a dataset, MRI acquisition parameters (e.g., scanner manufacturer, field strength) also varied. Such differences may introduce systematic biases in retrieval performance.
blocks.zh: 每个数据集都是根据不同的研究规程获得的,并包括不同的群体。 此外,在一个数据集中,核磁共振的获取参数(例如扫描仪制造商、野外强度)也各不相同。 这种差异可能给检索工作带来系统性偏见。

blocks.en: To investigate these effects, the NeuroCBIR system was evaluated using query subsets defined by scanner field strength (1.5T or 3T) and by manufacturer (GE, Philips, or Siemens). In these analyses, only images from a given subset served as queries, while retrieval was performed against the full database. For example, when evaluating 1.5T queries, all 1.5T images were used as queries, but the reference database included all images, keeping the pool of candidate images constant across subsets.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这些效应,使用扫描仪场强度(1.5T或3T)和制造商(GE,Philips,或Siemens)定义的查询子集对神经CBIR系统进行了评价. 在这些分析中,只有某一子集的图像作为查询,而检索则根据整个数据库进行。 例如,在评价1.5T查询时,所有1.5T图像都被用作查询,但参考数据库包括了所有图像,使候选图像的集合在子集之间保持不变.

blocks.en: For each query, the Prec@5 was computed as the proportion of relevant images among the top-5 retrieved results. Collecting the Prec@5 values across all queries yields a distribution of retrieval performance for each subset (e.g., 1.5T, 3T, GE, Philips, and Siemens). Since the distributions of Prec@5 along queries did not follow normality, the non-parametric test of Mann–Whitney U test was used to assess statistically significant differences between subsets. Additionally, Cliff’s δ \delta was calculated to quantify the effect size, providing a measure of the magnitude of differences independent of sample size. blocks.en: 2.8 Comparison with pretrained models
blocks.zh: 2.8 与预训模型的比较

blocks.en: To benchmark the performance of our proposed NeuroCBIR system, we evaluated several commonly used 3D feature extractors trained on medical imaging cohorts. The tested models included standard 3D ResNet architectures (ResNet-10, ResNet-50, ResNet-101) from MONAI ( Hara et al., 2018 ; He et al., 2016 ; Chen et al., 2019 ; Cardoso et al., 2022 ) , a 3D-CNN pre-trained model for brain T1-weighted MRI for AD diagnosis (CNN-AD) ( Turrisi et al., 2024 ) , and a large-scale medical vision model based on the transformer Swin UNETR (VoComni-L) ( Hatamizadeh et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024b ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Cardoso et al., 2022 ) . For all ResNet models and VoComni-L, we extracted features from the deepest encoder layers, followed by global average pooling to obtain fixed-size embeddings. Additionally, we evaluated the performance of our VAE-based embeddings projecting with UMAP ( McInnes et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了衡量我们提议的神经-CBIR系统的业绩,我们评价了几个常用的3D特性提取器,这些提取器是经过医学成像组别培训的。 测试过的模型包括来自MONAI(Hara等,2018年;He等,2016年;Chen等,2019年;Cardoso等,2022年)的标准3D ResNet架构(ResNet-10,ResNet-50,ResNet-101),一个用于AD诊断(CNN-AD)(Turrisi等,2024年;基于变压器Swin UNETR(VoComni-L)(Hatamizadeh等,2022年;Wu等,2024b;Wu等,2024a;Cardosa等,2022年)。 对于所有ResNet模型和VoComni-L,我们从最深的编码层中提取出特征,然后是全球平均集合,以获得固定大小的嵌入. 此外,我们还评估了我们基于VAE的嵌入式项目与UMAP的性能(McInnes等,2020年)。

blocks.en:
Additionally, two 3D brain foundational models were added to the comparison: BrainIAC ( Tak et al., 2026 ) and FOMO2JOMO ( Munk et al., 2026 ) . BrainIAC was trained on 48 965 48\,965 brain MRIs with different contrasts (T1w, T2w, T2-FLAIR, contrast-enhanced T1w) across a broad spectrum of tasks. This model outperformed localized supervised training and other pretrained models, particularly in low-data, few-shot settings and in high-difficulty prediction tasks, allowing for application in scenarios otherwise infeasible.
The method leverages self-supervised foundation models pretrained using SimCLR and masked autoencoders on 3D brain MRI. For the present work, all images were adapted to fit with their preprocessing steps ( Tak et al., 2026 ) . In turn, FOMO2JOMO, was the winner of the MICCAI 2025 challenge FOMO25 This method uses a similar loss function to ours for training their model, i.e, they try to pull together images from the same subject while pushing apart those from different modalities. The method pretrained a 3D CNN multi-modal UNet-style VAE with 18.9M parameters. This model uses patches of size [ 64 , 64 , 64 64,64,64 ] rather than the entire image ( Munk et al., 2026 ) . Thus, we used the central cropped brain volume to extract the mean values of the subject-level latent representations in the VAE bottleneck. Every mean value has a raw dimension of [ 256 , 4 , 4 , 4 256,4,4,4 ] and were global averaged pooled to 256 features.
blocks.zh:
此外,在比较中增加了两个三维脑基模型:BrainIAC(Tak等人,2026年)和FOMO2JOMO(Munk等人,2026年)。 BrainIAC接受了48个965个48\,965个有不同对比度(T1w,T2w,T2-FLAIR,对比增强的T1w)的脑MRI的训练,涉及范围很广的任务. 这种模型的绩效超过了局部监督培训和其他预先训练的模型,特别是在低数据、少镜头环境和高度困难的预测任务中,允许在本来不可行的情景中应用。
该方法在3D脑核磁共振上利用自控基础模型使用SimCLR和蒙面自编码器进行预训. 就本作而言,所有图像都经过了调整,以符合其预处理步骤(Tak等,2026年)。 而FOMO2JOMO则是MICCAI 2025挑战FOMO25的得主. 这种方法使用与我们相似的失能功能来训练他们的模型,即他们试图从同一个主体中拉出图像,同时推出不同模式的图像. 该方法预训了有18.9M参数的3D CNN多式UNet型VAE. 这个模型使用大小[64.,64.64,64.64]的补丁来代替整个图像(Munk等,2026.). 因此,我们利用中央收割的大脑体积,提取出VAE瓶颈中主体一级潜在表现的平均值. 每个平均值的原始维度为[256、4、4、4、256、4、4],全球平均集合到256个特征。

blocks.en: 2.9 Computational complexity
blocks.zh: 2.9 计算复杂性

blocks.en: The execution time of the NeuroCBIR system is critical for assessing its feasibility in real-time applications. In clinical practice, the dataset of embeddings is precomputed in advance. Therefore, during inference, the main factors that determine efficiency are loading the Q2E module, processing the query to generate its embedding, and computing the pairwise cosine similarity with the precomputed embedding dataset, followed by sorting and retrieving the top matches.
blocks.zh: NeuroCBIR系统的执行时间对于评估其实时应用的可行性至关重要. 在临床实践中,嵌入物的数据集事先预先计算. 因此,在推论中,决定效率的主要因素是加载Q2E模块,处理查询生成其嵌入,并计算出与预计算嵌入数据集的对等余弦相似性,然后对顶端匹配进行分拣并取回.

blocks.en: All execution times reported in the current study were obtained on a system with the following characteristics: PyTorch was configured to use 1 and 4 CPU threads. The platform was Linux 4.18.0 running on an x86_64 machine with an Intel ® Xeon ® Gold 6226R CPU @ 2.90 GHz.
blocks.zh: 本研究报告中报告的所有执行时间都是在一个具有以下特点的系统中取得的: PyTorch被配置为使用1和4个CPU线程. 该站台为Linux 4.1.8. 运行在一台x86_64的机器上,并搭载了一台英特尔-Xeon-Gold 6226R CPU@ 2.90 GHz.

blocks.en: 2.10 Application-specific experimental setups
blocks.zh: 2.10 具体应用的实验装置

blocks.en: To further assess the clinical relevance of the learned embeddings beyond retrieval performance, we conducted application-specific evaluations. These analyses test whether the NeuroCBIR framework captures meaningful biological and disease-related patterns in a fully zero-shot setting.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估所学到的嵌入物的临床相关性,我们进行了针对应用的评估。 这些分析测试了神经-CBIR框架是否在完全零发的情况下捕捉到有意义的生物和疾病相关模式.

blocks.en: Zero-shot evaluation refers to applying the learned NeuroCBIR embeddings to new tasks, such as age estimation or disease risk inference, without any task-specific training or fine-tuning, allowing us to assess whether the embeddings capture clinically meaningful information in a fully generalizable and unbiased manner ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Bazine et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 零发评价是指将所学的神经CBIR嵌入到年龄估计或疾病风险推论等新任务中去,而没有任何针对具体任务的培训或微调,使我们能够评估嵌入是否以充分概括和无偏见的方式获取临床上有意义的信息(Guo等,2025;Bazine等,2024)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Hyperparameter optimization
blocks.zh: 3.1 超参数优化

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes the hyperparameter optimization results for the whole-brain retrieval model. Performance was primarily assessed using mAP@5, reflecting short-range retrieval accuracy, while embedding-level perceptual alignment was evaluated via Spearman’s rank correlation with MS-SSIM ( ρ MS ​ - ​ SSIM \rho_{\mathrm{MS\text{-}SSIM}} ). Across configurations, higher retrieval performance generally coincided with stronger (more negative) correlations, indicating improved consistency between embedding similarity and perceptual image similarity. The final configuration was selected based on the highest mAP@5 score, corresponding to N f = 32 N_{f}=32 , α hn = 0.2 \alpha_{\mathrm{hn}}=0.2 , α sn = 0.2 \alpha_{\mathrm{sn}}=0.2 , λ sn = 0.2 \lambda_{\mathrm{sn}}=0.2 , and π hn = 5 \pi_{\mathrm{hn}}=5 . This setting was used for all subsequent whole-brain experiments. To ensure a fair and consistent comparison, the same hyperparameter configuration was also adopted for the region-based retrieval approach.

blocks.en: Moreover, we performed three ablation experiments by setting λ sn = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{sn}}=0 , λ hn = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{hn}}=0 , or both (last three rows of Table 3 ). The results indicate distinct roles for the two loss terms. Removing the soft-negative loss markedly reduces retrieval performance (mAP@5: 98.6% to 79.0%), whereas removing the hard-negative loss preserves high retrieval accuracy but substantially weakens the agreement with perceptual similarity ( ρ MS − SSIM \rho_{\mathrm{MS-SSIM}} : − 0.71 -0.71 to − 0.01 -0.01 ). Although removing both loss terms yields the highest mAP@5, the resulting embedding is considerably less consistent with MS-SSIM, supporting the inclusion of both losses in the final configuration.

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that the whole-brain NeuroCBIR framework achieves consistently high retrieval performance across testing query datasets, with mAP and mS exceeding 95% for most cases. Performance is near-perfect on the training set and remains robust on both the test subset and three external datasets, indicating strong generalization. The smaller datasets, such as AIBL and SLIM, show slightly lower mS@1 due to limited longitudinal sample data per subject and the lack of repeated scans per subject, which makes retrieval more challenging. By contrast, MIRIAD includes multiple scans per subject at similar time points, facilitating retrieval and explaining its higher scores despite a similar sample size. In contrast, mS@5 consistently approaches 100% across datasets, confirming the reliability of the system for retrieving highly relevant matches. blocks.en: The drop in performance for certain brain regions in Table 5 could be associated with multiple reasons: (i) the extra postprocessing step required for segmenting these regions. (ii) Because of the limited longitudinal samples per subject (e.g., AIBL and SLIM), it highlights the influence of dataset size and variability on retrieval performance. (iii) ADNI and MIRIAD datasets contain repeated measures of the same scan for the same session, which is reflected in the higher performance with respect to OASIS3, AIBL, and SLIM, which only contain an MRI scan per session. (iv) Additionally, small or homogeneous structures such as the amygdala and thalamus may not exhibit overtly distinct individual patterns, resulting in lower retrieval performance. Notably, increasing the retrieval rank from mS@1 to mS@5 consistently improves, approaching 100% for most structures, which demonstrates the robustness of the embeddings in reliably retrieving relevant matches. blocks.en: The CV of the Spearman correlations across regions and across queries highlights the relative heterogeneity of regional contributions to whole-brain similarity (Figure 8 ). In contrast, higher CV values are observed in cortical regions such as the right parahippocampal, caudal anterior cingulate, entorhinal, and temporal pole cortices, reflecting greater query-dependent variability.

blocks.en: Table 6 outlines the statistical comparisons between different classes, datasets, scanner field strengths, and manufacturers, including p-values and effect sizes (Cliff’s δ). Most inter-dataset comparisons, such as test vs. training and ADNI vs OASIS3, showed highly significant differences (p <0.001) but with negligible to small effect sizes. This finding indicates that although statistically detectable, the practical differences are limited. Comparisons involving the MIRIAD dataset generally exhibited smaller differences, reflecting its relative similarity to other datasets. classes, field strengths, and manufacturer comparisons revealed minimal effects, with most Cliff’s δvalues close to zero, confirming that these factors had a negligible impact on distributions. Overall, the table highlights that while statistical significance is observed in many pairwise tests, the effect sizes are mostly negligible or small, suggesting robust generalization across datasets and acquisition conditions.

blocks.en: Table 7 compares retrieval performance across different feature extractors and embedding strategies. While standard CNN backbones and pretrained vision models achieve moderate retrieval accuracy, NeuroCBIR markedly outperforms all baselines, reaching a mAP@5 of 98.3% and a mS@5 of 99.8% with only 32 features. Importantly, NeuroCBIR also shows a strong negative Spearman correlation with MS-SSIM ( ρ MS ​ - ​ SSIM = − 0.74 \rho_{\mathrm{MS\text{-}SSIM}}=-0.74 ), indicating close agreement between embedding-based similarity rankings and perceptual image similarity. In contrast, baseline models exhibit weaker correlations, suggesting less structured and less interpretable embedding spaces.

blocks.en: 3.6 Computational complexity
blocks.zh: 3.6 计算的复杂性

blocks.en: Table 8 summarizes the execution time and memory requirements of the NeuroCBIR system for both whole-brain and brain-region processing. As expected, compared to brain-region retrieval, whole-brain retrieval is more computationally demanding, with the Q2E forward pass requiring on average 66.4 seconds on a single core and 18.7 seconds on four cores, accompanied by a peak memory usage of 6.8 GB. In contrast, region-specific retrieval is substantially more efficient, reducing both memory consumption (peak 1.4 GB) and processing time (3.6 seconds on a single core and 1.2 seconds on four cores). In both cases, the retrieval step itself (top-5 similarity search) required negligible time (<0.01 seconds), confirming that the system is dominated by the embedding extraction step.
blocks.zh: 表8汇总了神经CBIR系统对全脑和脑区域处理的执行时间和内存要求. 如所料,与大脑-区域检索相比,全脑检索在计算上要求更高,Q2E前传平均需要单核66.4秒,四核18.7秒,同时峰值内存使用6.8GB. 相形之下,针对区域的检索效率要高得多,既能减少内存消耗(峰值1.4 GB)又能减少处理时间(单核上为3.6秒,四核上为1.2秒). 在这两种情况下,取回步骤本身(top-5相似性搜索)需要可忽略的时间(<0.01秒),证实系统由嵌入取取取步骤所主导.

blocks.en: 3.7 Application-specific evaluation

blocks.en: Next, we evaluated the performance of the embeddings in zero-shot tasks, testing whether they capture meaningful age- and disease-related patterns without supervision.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们评价了嵌入零镜头任务中的性能,测试它们是否在没有监督的情况下捕捉到有意义的与年龄和疾病有关的模式.

blocks.en: 3.7.1 Zero-shot similarity-based age inference
blocks.zh: 3.7.1 零射出类似年龄推论

blocks.en: Table 9 summarizes zero-shot age estimation performance across selected brain regions using the top- 500 500 retrieved cases from the different methods, including a random baseline with 4 random features and the ablation cases. . Overall, the results indicate that similarity-based retrieval captures meaningful age-related structure in both global and regional brain representations in a fully zero-shot setting. The whole-brain approach achieves the best performance, with a MAE of 4.3 years and a Pearson correlation of r = 0.54 r=0.54 , outperforming all individual region-based estimates as well as the alternative embedding approaches evaluated in this study.
blocks.zh: 表9利用从不同方法中提取的500个最大病例,包括4个随机特征的随机基线和膨胀病例,汇总了选定大脑区域的零射入年龄估计绩效。 总体而言,结果表明,基于相似性的检索在全零射入的环境下,在全球和区域大脑表现中都能够捕捉有意义的年龄相关结构。 全脑方法取得最佳业绩,最高比率为4.3年,而皮尔逊系数为0.54 r=0.54, 优于基于各区域的所有估计数以及本研究所评价的替代嵌入方法。

blocks.en: The ablation results show that both loss terms contribute to the learned representations, with removing the hard-negative loss producing the largest degradation (MAE = 5.2 years, r = 0.09 r=0.09 ), while removing the soft-negative loss resulted in a smaller decrease (MAE = 4.7 years, r = 0.49 r=0.49 ).

blocks.en: 3.7.2 Zero-shot similarity-based disease risk estimation
blocks.zh: 3.7.2 零射出基于相似性的疾病风险估计

blocks.en: Table 10 summarizes the performance of zero-shot similarity-based disease risk estimation across brain regions using top- 500 500 retrieved neighbors for the different tested methods, including a random baseline with 4 features and the ablation cases. Across all regions, performance exceeds chance level (BAcc = 33%), with BAcc ranging from 49.7% (left thalamus) to 57.9% (left amygdala) and MF1 scores between 45.8% and 55.3%. Whole-brain embeddings achieve a BAcc of 56.3% and a MF1 of 53.1%, outperforming the alternative embedding approaches evaluated in this study.
blocks.zh: 表10汇总了各脑区零发相类似性疾病风险估计的绩效,其中使用了500个回收量最高的邻居,用于不同测试方法,包括具有4个特征的随机基线和衰竭病例。 在所有地区,表现都超过了机会水平(BAcc=33%),BAcc从49.7%(左地峡)到57.9%(左地峡),MF1的得分在45.8%到55.3%之间. 全脑嵌入法达到56.3%的BAcc和53.1%的MF1,比本研究评估的替代嵌入法表现优异.

blocks.en: The ablation results indicate that both the soft-negative and hard-negative losses contribute to the quality of the learned embeddings. Removing the soft-negative loss reduced the three-class balanced accuracy from 56.3% to 54.1%, whereas removing the hard-negative loss caused a much larger drop to 38.4% (binary: 76.7% to 55.4%), demonstrating the importance of both objectives, particularly the hard-negative term.
blocks.zh: 减速结果表明,软负和硬负两方面的损失都有助于提高所学嵌入的质量. 消除软阴性损失将三等平衡精度从56.3%降至54.1%,而去除硬阴性损失则导致大幅下降至38.4%(二分数:76.7%降至55.4%),这表明了这两个目标,特别是硬阴性术语的重要性.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this study, we demonstrated that NeuroCBIR achieves high retrieval (re-identification) performance at both the whole-brain (mAP@5 ∼ \sim 98.4) and brain-region levels, with most anatomical structures showing consistently strong results. The Spearman’s correlation between the embedding-space and MS-SSIM ( ρ MS − SSIM \rho_{\mathrm{MS-SSIM}} ) further confirms that the learned embeddings preserve meaningful perceptual and semantic similarities between inter-subject scans. These results indicate that the embeddings capture anatomically meaningful patterns that are consistent not only within subjects but also across different individuals. Evaluation across multiple large-scale datasets, varying field strengths, and scanner manufacturers further demonstrates that the framework generalizes robustly under heterogeneous acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们证明神经化学IR在全脑(mAP@5 ∼\sim 98.4)和脑-区域水平上都实现了高检索(再识别)性能,大多数解剖结构都显示出一贯的强效效果. Spearman的嵌入空间和MS-SSIM( ^ MS- SSIM \rho_{\- mathrm{ MS- SSIM}})之间的关联进一步证实了所学入子在主体间扫描之间保持了有意义的知觉和语义上的相似性. 这些结果表明,嵌入物不仅在主体内部而且在不同个人之间都具有解剖意义。 跨多个大型数据集的评价、不同的实地优势和扫描仪制造商进一步表明,框架在不同的获取条件下得到了有力的概括。

blocks.en: Traditional CBIR systems, particularly for brain MRI, have been predominantly evaluated based on their ability to retrieve images sharing the same class labels, such as tumor types or diagnostic categories like CN vs. AD ( Huang et al., 2012 ; Onga et al., 2019 ; Nishimaki et al., 2022 ; Muraki et al., 2024 ; Tobari et al., 2025 ) . However, class labels provide only coarse population-level grouping and do not reflect fine-grained inter-individual neuroanatomical variability. Similarly, metrics like SSIM or other pixel-level similarity measures are often avoided as ground truth because they are highly sensitive to registration errors, intensity variations, and scanner-specific artifacts, which can confuse retrieval in large multi-cohort datasets ( Dohmen et al., 2025 ; Renieblas et al., 2017 ) . While effective for image registration or quality assessment, such metrics emphasize local intensity correspondence rather than higher-level anatomical structure. Consequently, both class-based and pixel-level similarity metrics fail to capture subtle, subject-specific anatomical patterns that are crucial for meaningful brain MRI retrieval.
blocks.zh: 传统的CBIR系统,特别是大脑核磁共振系统,主要依据其检索相同分类标签的图像的能力进行了评估,如:同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同为一等同一等同为一等同为一等同一等同为一等同一等同为一等同一等同一等同为一等同一等同为一等同一等同一等同为一等同一等同一等同为一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同为一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同一等同为一等同一等同一等同一等同 然而,类标签只提供粗糙的人口级分组,不反映细纹的个人神经解剖间可变性. 类似地,SSIM等像素级类似度测量常被避免作为地表真理,因为它们对注册错误,强度变化和扫描仪特定文物高度敏感,这可能会混淆大型多曲线数据集中的检索(Dohmen等,2025;Renieblas等,2017). 这种衡量标准虽然对图像登记或质量评估有效,但强调地方强度对应,而不是更高层次的解剖结构。 因此,基于类和像素水平的相似度测量都未能捕捉到对于有意义的脑磁共振检索至关重要的微妙、针对具体对象的解剖模式。

blocks.en:
We address these limitations by using same-subject images as ground truth for similarity, guiding the model to focus on subject-specific global/regional brain structure and pulling corresponding scans closer in the embedding space. At the same time, we leverage a VAE-trained latent space that captures fine-grained anatomical patterns across subjects, enabling anatomically similar scans to cluster while dissimilar ones are pushed apart. Learning compact latent representations with autoencoders, including variational autoencoders, has been widely adopted in CBIR systems to support similarity-based retrieval beyond hand-crafted features ( Rafiei and Iosifidis, 2023 ; Wang et al., 2004 ) .
The ablation analysis provides further insight into the role of the contrastive objectives. In agreement with previous contrastive learning studies showing that negative sample selection strongly influences representation quality ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Khosla et al., 2020 ) , our results indicate that the hard-negative and soft-negative terms contribute differently. The hard-negative term primarily improves the alignment between embedding similarity and anatomical similarity, increasing the correlation with MS-SSIM ( ρ MS ​ - ​ SSIM \rho_{\mathrm{MS\text{-}SSIM}} : − 0.01 -0.01 to − 0.71 -0.71 ). The soft-negative term improves retrieval robustness by refining similarity relationships, encouraging anatomically similar brains to lie closer to the query’s positive samples while maintaining separation from hard negatives (mAP@5: 79.0 % 79.0\% to 97.0 % 97.0\% ).
blocks.zh:
我们通过使用同题图像作为相似性的地面真理,指导模型侧重于针对特定主题的全球/区域大脑结构,并拉近嵌入空间中的相应扫描,来解决这些局限性. 同时,我们利用一个受VAE训练的潜在空间,它能够捕捉到不同主体之间精细的解剖规律,使解剖学上相似的扫描能够集群,而不同的扫描则被推开. CBIR系统广泛采用了包括可变自编码器在内的自动编码器的学习紧凑潜在表示,以支持在手动特性之外进行基于相似性的检索(Rafiei和Iosifidis,2023;Wang等,2004)。
衰减分析对对比目标的作用提供了更深入的见解. 我们同意以往的对比性学习研究表明,负面样本选择对代表质量有重大影响(Chen等,2020年;Khosla等,2020年),结果表明,硬阴性词和软阴性词不同。 硬负词主要改善嵌入相似性和解剖相似性之间的对接,增加了与MS-SSIM的关联性(^ MS-rho_{\-mathrm{MS\text{-}SSIM}}:− 0.01-0.01至−0.71). 软阴性术语通过完善相似性关系,鼓励解剖学上相近的大脑靠近查询的正取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取

blocks.en: The publication most closely related to our work is that of Puglisi et al. (2024) , which addresses the task of locating previous scans of the same patient, commonly referred to as subject re-identification. They proposed DeepBrainPrint, a framework that generates subject-specific fingerprints from 2D T1-weighted MR images. Their evaluation, conducted on ADNI and a synthetic benchmark comprising 142 images, defined retrieval success as returning scans from the same subject among the top-ranked results. Reported performance was high, with mAP@3 values of 95.5% on ADNI and 91% on the synthetic dataset ( Puglisi et al., 2024 ) . While this work demonstrates the feasibility of subject-level MRI retrieval, our approach differs in both scope and methodology. First, we extend retrieval to large-scale datasets comprising thousands of 3D T1-weighted MRIs, explicitly evaluating generalization across scanners and acquisition protocols. Second, beyond enforcing subject-level similarity, our latent space is jointly structured to preserve inter-subject anatomical relationships, enabling the learned features to support downstream tasks such as zero-shot age regression and pathology classification. Finally, our region-based formulation allows retrieval to focus on anatomically localized patterns when regional effects dominate over global structure, facilitating task-specific stratification in subsequent analyses.
blocks.zh: 与我们的工作关系最密切的出版物是Puglisi等人(2024年)的出版物,该出版物涉及查找同一患者先前扫描的任务,通常被称为主体再识别. 他们提出了DeepBrainPrint,这个框架从2D T1加权的MR图像中生成特定对象的指纹. 他们根据ADNI和由142个图像组成的合成基准进行的评价,将检索成功定义为从同一主题的同级结果中返回扫描。 报告的性能很高,MAP@3值在ADNI上为95.5%,在合成数据集上为91%(Puglisi等人,2024年)。 虽然这项工作表明在主题一级检索核磁共振的可行性,但我们的做法在范围和方法上各不相同。 首先,我们把检索范围扩大到包括上千个3D T1加权MRI的大型数据集,明确评价扫描仪和获取协议的通用性。 第二,除了强制执行主题层面的相似性外,我们的潜在空间是共同结构的,以维护主题间解剖关系,使学到的特征能够支持下游任务,如零射年龄回归和病理分类. 最后,我们以区域为基础的配方使检索能够侧重于在区域影响凌驾于全球结构之上的解剖本地化模式,从而便利在随后的分析中进行针对具体任务的分层。

blocks.en:
Through the evaluation of NeuroCBIR on unsupervised tasks, including zero-shot age prediction and pathology stratification, we aim to demonstrate that the learned embedding features encode both age-related and disease-related anatomical patterns. To the best of our knowledge, there are no prior studies that perform brain age estimation purely through unsupervised, zero-shot, retrieval-based embeddings without supervised age labels during training. Our method achieves an MAE of ∼ \sim 4.3 4.3 years and a Pearson correlation of r ∼ r\sim 0.5 across the evaluated brain regions. While our method is not tailored for age prediction, it achieved competitive results compared to supervised brain age regression models reported in the literature. For example, in ( Dartora et al., 2024 ) , we achieved MAEs between 2.67 and 3 years with a regression model optimized for brain age. Similarly, on the external AIBL cohort, NeuroCBIR achieved an MAE of 4.5 4.5 years, compared with 3.8 3.8 years reported by the supervised brain age estimation model of Rajabli et al. (2025) . Brain age estimation methods use standard interpretability methods, such as gradCAM ( Dartora et al., 2024 ; Rajabli et al., 2025 ) .
Instead of competing with brain age regression methods, NeuroCBIR can be used to add interpretability. Indeed, since our framework estimates age directly from the top- k k most similar brains in the database, it is possible to perform fine-grained analysis by inspecting differences in age between the query and retrieved scans and possibly detecting outliers.
blocks.zh:
通过对NeuroCBIR对无监督任务的评价,包括零射入年龄预测和病理分层,我们力求证明所学入地特征编码了与年龄有关的和与疾病有关的解剖模式。 据我们所知,在培训期间,没有任何研究完全通过不受监督的零镜头和基于检索的嵌入进行大脑年龄估计。 我们的方法在评估的大脑区域中 达到 \\ sim 4.3 年 和 pearson 相关 r r\ sim 0.5 。 虽然我们的方法不适应年龄预测,但与文献中报告的受监督的大脑年龄回归模型相比,它取得了竞争性结果. 例如,在(Dartora等,2024年)中,我们实现了2.67至3年的MAEs,并优化了针对大脑年龄的回归模型. 同样,在外部的AIBL组群中,NeuroCBIR的MAE为4.5年,而Rajabli等人(2025年)的受监督的大脑年龄估计模型报告的MAE为3.8年。 大脑年龄估计方法采用标准可解释性方法,如gradCAM(Dartora等,2024;Rajabli等,2025)。
神经CBIR不与大脑年龄回归法相竞争,而是可以用来添加可解释性. 事实上,由于我们的框架直接从数据库中最相似的大脑中估算出年龄,因此可以通过检查查询和检索扫描之间的年龄差异以及可能检测出值来进行精细分析。

blocks.en: Additionally, consistent with observations in supervised brain age models ( Soumya Kumari and Sundarrajan, 2024 ; Dartora et al., 2024 ) , we also report an AD-related age gap when predictions are based on CN reference datasets (see Figure 9 ). This shift reflects disease-related morphological patterns that resemble accelerated normative aging, despite the absence of explicit disease supervision during training.
blocks.zh: 此外,根据受监督的脑龄模型(Soumya Kumari和Sundarrajan, 2024;Dartora等人, 2024)中的观测结果,我们还报告在根据氯化萘参考数据集进行预测时存在与反倾销有关的年龄差距(见图9)。 这种转变反映了与疾病有关的形态模式,这种模式与加快规范老化相似,尽管在培训期间没有明确的疾病监督。

blocks.en:
Regarding zero-shot pathology prediction, whole-brain embeddings achieve a balanced accuracy of 56.3% and a MF1 score of 53.1% across CN, MCI, and AD. Most misclassifications between CN and AD occur toward the MCI class, reflecting its intermediate clinical status and supporting the biological plausibility of the learned embedding space.

On the external AIBL cohort, NeuroCBIR achieved balanced accuracies of 75.2 % 75.2\% using whole-brain embeddings and 81.9 % 81.9\% using the left amygdala for the CN/AD classification task, without any retraining or domain adaptation. These results approach the 84.0 % 84.0\% reported by the supervised classifier of Wen et al. (2020) , which is slightly better than their results on ADNI data ( Persson et al., 2026 ) .
Prior unsupervised approaches have also explored AD detection via clustering of MRI features ( Inguanzo et al., 2023 ) or anomaly detection with autoencoder-based representations ( Kim and Shin, 2026 ) , showing that disease-related patterns can be captured without labeled training data. Importantly, our framework demonstrates zero-shot multi-class classification across CN, MCI, and AD using fully unsupervised embeddings, showing that meaningful disease-related structure can be captured without any training with task-specific labels.
blocks.zh:
关于零发病理学预测,全脑嵌入在氯化萘、MCI和AD的MF1分数中均匀精确度达到56.3%并达到53.1%。 氯化萘和AD之间的大多数分类错误发生在MCI类,反映了其中间临床状态,支持所学嵌入空间的生物可信性。

在外部AIBL组群中,NeuroCBIR使用全脑嵌入法实现了75.2%的平衡速率,81.9%的平衡速率使用左阿米格达拉进行CN/AD分类任务,而没有任何再培训和域调整。 这些结果接近监督的Wen等人(2020年)分类者报告的84.0% 84.0%,这略好于其在ADNI数据上的结果(Persson等人,2026年)。
先前未受监督的方法也探索了通过对核磁共振特征(Inguanzo等,2023年)进行分组检测,或用自编码器表示的异常检测(Kim和Shin,2026年),表明无需贴标签的培训数据就可以捕捉出与疾病有关的模式. 重要的是,我们的框架展示了使用完全不受监督的嵌入物对氯化萘、MCI和AD进行零射多级分类,表明无需经过任何带有特定任务标签的培训就可以捕捉到有意义的疾病相关结构。

blocks.en: Researchers from the Division of Clinical Geriatrics at Karolinska Institutet created TheHiveDB ( Muehlboeck et al., 2014 ) , a system that allows users to retrieve images using specific search criteria (e.g., diagnosis, age, sex, biomarkers, memory tests, scanner, etc.). Notice that we decided not to consider any additional variable in the training of NeuroCBIR beyond image similarity to ease its integration into systems such as The HiveDB. NeuroCBIR can be integrated into TheHiveDB or other search systems to add an extra dimension of image similarity, which could be used to answer different research questions by filtering the results from NeuroCBIR with additional criteria. Thus, with NeuroCBIR, users could evaluate images alongside associated clinical records. Moreover, new scans can be added directly to the database without retraining the model, enabling the system to continuously improve coverage and utility as additional data becomes available. Regarding pure re-identification, NeuroCBIR can be used for detecting images from the same subject that, due to human errors, were assigned to different subject IDs, something that is not uncommon in ADNI, for example. The relatively good performance of NeuroCBIR on zero-shot tasks of brain age and classification points to a correlation between image similarity, age, and condition, which is interesting to further study in the future.
blocks.zh: 卡罗林斯卡研究所临床老年医学司的研究人员创建了"TheHiveDB"(Muehlboeck等,2014年),该系统允许用户使用特定的搜索标准(如诊断,年龄,性别,生物标记,内存测试,扫描仪等)来取回图像. 注意到我们决定不考虑在NeuroCBIR的训练中除了图像相似性之外的任何其他变量,以方便其融入"蜂巢"等系统. NeuroCBIR可以被集成到"TheHiveDB"或其他搜索系统中来增加一个图像相似度的额外维度,可以通过用附加标准过滤NeuroCBIR的结果来解答不同的研究问题. 因此,有了神经化学反应中心,用户可以评估图像和相关的临床记录。 此外,新的扫描可以直接添加到数据库中,而不对模型进行再培训,使该系统能够在获得更多数据后不断提高覆盖面和效用。 关于纯粹的再识别,NeuroCBIR可用于检测由于人为错误而被分配到不同主题ID的同一个主题的图像,这在ADNI中并不罕见. NeuroCBIR在大脑年龄和分类的零射入任务上的相对良好的表现,指出了图像相似性,年龄,和条件之间的关联性,这在未来值得进一步研究.

blocks.en: A central motivation for adopting latent representations from VAEs rather than raw 3D brain MRIs lies in both computational efficiency and semantic compactness. Direct processing of volumetric scans is prohibitively memory-intensive: for example, training the VAE with a batch size of just one whole-brain MRI required ∼ \sim 63 GB of GPU memory in our experiments. Once trained, the encoder alone requires ∼ \sim 20 GB to process a single image (batch size = 1). By precomputing the latent embeddings 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} , the input size is reduced from [160, 176, 208] voxels to [8, 20, 22, 26], representing a drastic compression of the 3D volume. This reduction makes it possible to perform contrastive training with significantly larger batch sizes that would otherwise be infeasible. Such efficiency is crucial, since contrastive learning methods rely on large and diverse batches to achieve robust representations ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 采用VAE的潜在表示而不是原始的3D脑MRI的中心动机在于计算效率和语义紧凑性。 直接处理体积扫描是令人望而却步的内存密集型:例如,用一个整脑核磁共振的批量尺寸来训练VAE,在我们实验中需要\\ sim 63 GB的GPU内存. 被训练后,仅编码器就要求\\ sim 20 GB处理单个图像(批量大小=1). 通过预先计算出潜入的嵌入μ\boldsymbol\mu},输入大小从[160,176,208] voxels减少到了[8,20,22,26],代表了3D卷的剧烈压缩. 由于这种减少,可以进行大得多的批量训练,否则是行不通的。 这种效率至关重要,因为对比性学习方法依靠大量不同的批次,才能实现有力的表述(Cheng等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Despite these contributions, our study has several limitations. First, we restricted our analysis to T1w MRI. Thus, retraining would be needed for other sequences. Second, the approach relies on preprocessing steps, particularly skull-stripping, that are essential to prevent the embeddings from capturing face-related rather than brain-related patterns. These steps add additional time and complexity to a clinical workflow. New fast and accurate deep learning-based methods (e.g., Hoopes et al. (2022) ) could reduce that issue.
Moreover, although the system was evaluated on data preprocessed with pipelines slightly different from the training data, it remains unclear how robust the model is to substantially different preprocessing strategies.
blocks.zh:
尽管作出了这些贡献,我们的研究仍然有一些局限性。 首先,我们仅限于T1w核磁共振分析。 因此,其他序列需要再培训。 第二,这种方法依赖于预处理步骤,特别是头骨剥取,这些步骤对于防止嵌入物捕捉出与面相相关的而非与大脑相关的模式至关重要. 这些步骤增加了临床工作流程的时间和复杂性。 新的快速和准确的深入学习方法(如Hoopes等人(2022年))可以减少这一问题。
此外,虽然对该系统进行了评估,其预处理数据与培训数据略有不同,但尚不清楚该模型在多大程度上能够使预处理战略大相径庭。

blocks.en: Future work should address these limitations by extending the framework to other clinically relevant brain MRI sequences, such as FLAIR scans, streamlining preprocessing, and exploring methods to improve the transparency and explainability of latent representations. Additionally, the inclusion of additional cohorts could expand the dataset of precomputed features and enable a more comprehensive use for both clinical and research applications. Wachinger et al. (2015) used cortical surfaces for subject re-identification using FreeSurfer. At a local scale, the shape of the hippocampus can also be potentially used for re-identification ( DeKraker et al., 2022 ) . Thus, an interesting avenue to complement NeuroCBIR is to extract features from cortical surfaces. For usability, this approach will require fast and accurate methods for surface mesh extraction. However, despite promising results in the last few years (e.g., Zheng et al. (2025) ; Bongratz et al. (2024) ), this remains a difficult problem.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应当通过将框架扩大到其他临床相关的脑磁共振序列,如FLAIR扫描,精简预处理,并探索提高潜在表达的透明度和可解释性的方法来克服这些局限性。 此外,增加组群可以扩大预先计算特征的数据集,并使临床和研究应用得到更全面的利用。 Wachinger等人(2015年)使用皮质表面来使用FreeSurfer进行主体再识别. 在当地尺度上,河马的外形也可以被潜在地用于再识别(DeKraker等,2022.). 因此,补充NeuroCBIR的一个有趣的途径是从皮层表面取出地物. 就可用性而言,这种方法需要快速和准确的地表网取出方法。 然而,尽管在过去几年中取得了有希望的成果(如:郑等 (2025年);邦格拉茨等 (2024年)),这仍然是一个困难的问题.

blocks.en: This study primarily focuses on the development and technical validation of the NeuroCBIR framework. While the method was evaluated for scan re-identification and explored in zero-shot clinical scenarios, a more comprehensive investigation of these and additional clinical applications is warranted. Indeed, the relatively good performance of NeuroCBIR on zero-shot tasks of brain age and classification suggests a correlation among image similarity, age, and condition, which is worth further study. Future work should assess its potential for finer-grained tasks, such as the identification and stratification of dementia subtypes ( Inguanzo et al., 2023 ) . In addition, NeuroCBIR could serve as a perceptual and reasoning component within future AI systems: its embeddings and similarity-based retrieval may inform clinical or research decision-making, such as cohort selection or patient risk prioritization, providing a foundation for more agentic AI architectures with planning and action modules ( Abou Ali et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 本研究主要关注神经-CBIR框架的开发和技术验证. 虽然对扫描方法进行了评估,以重新识别,并在零发临床情况中进行了探索,但有必要更全面地调查这些和更多的临床应用。 事实上,神经CBIR在大脑年龄和分类的零射入任务上的表现相对较好,这表明了图像相似性、年龄和条件之间的关联性,值得进一步研究。 今后的工作应评估其开展更精细工作的潜力,例如确定和分层划分痴呆亚型(Inguanzo等,2023年)。 此外,NeuroCBIR可以作为未来AI系统中的感知和推理组成部分:其嵌入和基于相似性的检索可能为临床或研究决策提供参考,如组群选择或病人风险优先排序,为带有规划和行动模块的更代理AI架构提供基础(Abou Ali等,2025年).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: In this study, we present NeuroCBIR, a content-based image retrieval framework for brain MRI that supports both whole-brain and region-specific retrieval. The system leverages latent embeddings from a variational autoencoder combined with contrastive learning, allowing efficient and semantically meaningful representations of 3D T1w MRIs.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们介绍了NeuroCBIR,这是一个基于内容的脑磁共振图像检索框架,支持全脑和特定区域的检索. 该系统利用了由可变自编码器与对比性学习相结合而来的潜在嵌入,使得3D T1w MRI能够有效和精密地得到有意义的表述。

blocks.en: NeuroCBIR was evaluated with > 26 000 26\,000 MRI scans from five large-scale and complementary datasets (ADNI, OASIS3, AIBL, MIRIAD, and SLIM), encompassing a wide range of acquisition protocols, scanner manufacturers, and field strengths. The results consistently demonstrated a high retrieval performance: whole-brain embeddings achieved mAP@5 ≥ 98.4 % \geq 98.4\% , while region-specific retrieval provided strong performance across most brain anatomical structures. The Spearman’s correlation between the embedding-space and MS-SSIM ( ρ MS − SSIM \rho_{\mathrm{MS-SSIM}} ) further confirms that the learned embeddings preserve meaningful perceptual and semantic similarities between inter-subject scans. These findings confirm the robustness and generalization of the approach, even under heterogeneous imaging conditions.
blocks.zh: 从5个大型互补数据集(ADNI、OASIS3、AIBL、MIRIAD和SLIM)对NeuroCBIR进行了 > 26 000 26\0的磁共振扫描,包括广泛的购置协议、扫描仪制造商和现场优势。 研究结果始终表明检索性能很高:全脑嵌入已实现mAP@5 98.4%\geq 98.4%,而针对区域的检索则在大多数脑解剖结构中提供了强有力的性能。 Spearman的嵌入空间和MS-SSIM( ^ MS- SSIM \rho_{\- mathrm{ MS- SSIM}})之间的关联进一步证实了所学入子在主体间扫描之间保持了有意义的知觉和语义上的相似性. 这些结论证实,即使在不同的成像条件下,这一方法也是强有力的和普遍的。

blocks.en: Additionally, the embeddings demonstrate to capture rich, subject-specific anatomical patterns that support subject re-identification in large datasets, zero-shot age prediction and multi-class pathology stratification without any supervised training. By leveraging a retrieval-based approach, our framework provides interpretable predictions and reveals meaningful disease-related structure, including accelerated aging patterns in AD and intermediate representations for MCI. Importantly, because the embeddings are fully unsupervised and task-agnostic, they can be readily applied to a wide range of downstream neuroscience applications, offering a flexible and interpretable alternative to traditional supervised models while reducing reliance on large labeled datasets.
blocks.zh: 此外,嵌入物还显示,在没有接受任何监督培训的情况下,能够捕捉到丰富、针对主题的解剖模式,支持在大型数据集中重新识别对象、零镜头年龄预测和多级病理分层。 通过利用基于检索的方法,我们的框架提供了可解释的预测,并揭示了与疾病有关的有意义的结构,包括预警和中间反应的加速老化模式。 重要的是,由于嵌入体是完全不受监督的并具有任务不可知性的,它们可以很容易地被应用于广泛的下游神经科学应用中,为传统的被监督模型提供了灵活而可解释的替代品,同时减少了对被标记为大型数据集的依赖.

blocks.en: The embedding extraction on a 4-core CPU required ∼ \sim 18.7s per scan, whereas similarity search was virtually instantaneous (<0.01s). By making the code publicly available, the pretrained models and the precomputed features of > 26 000 26\,000 from five datasets, NeuroCBIR enables clinicians to retrieve structurally similar cases to support diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment decisions. For the research community, NeuroCBIR provides a reproducible platform for benchmarking and extending CBIR approaches in neuroimaging.
blocks.zh: 在4个核心CPU上嵌入提取需要\\sim 18.7s的每次扫描,而相似性搜索几乎是瞬间(<0.01s). 通过公开代码、预先训练的模型和5个数据集中 > 26 000 26/000的预计算特征,NeuroCBIR使临床医生能够检索结构类似的病例,以支持诊断、监测和治疗决定。 对于研究界来说,神经-CBIR提供了一个可复制的平台,用于在神经成像中制定基准和扩展CBIR方法.
